decisions.reason: The image filenames identify intended filler-image placement; they do not change the requirement to derive table-of-contents page numbers from finalized pagination.
The filler-image page assignments do not affect author names, matching author photos, photo sources, or byline placement.
The source assigns supplied filler images to pages and does not change article category labels or category mappings.
The placement metadata for filler images does not change the selected Inter font or its thicker readable treatment.
The intended page numbers saved with filler images are placement instructions, not final article page references for the cover.
The source concerns filler-image placement and does not alter the required shape or size of author photos.
Page assignments for filler images do not alter the prohibition on red in the Dorian Vale article or its reservation for the cover.
The source specifies where filler images belong but does not change two-page spread behavior or the even-page-count constraint.
The source refers to page-numbered filler images, not placement of the three required cover-mentioned articles.
The image-placement detail is already owned by the article-ending requirement and does not change the broad assembly behavior or Flat Plan reference.
The source does not identify the tribute page and does not alter its required inclusion or placement toward the end of the magazine.
Assigning filler images to intended pages does not change the polished, modern, Civic Lantern-aligned visual-style requirement.
